messages:
andrew: heads-up — noticed a perf regression in paged-attention paths after the latest FA merge. microbench (seq=2048, bs=8) shows 18% higher p95 token latency compared to last week
leila: ugh. can you paste the perf numbers? is this before or after our kernel selection fallback?
andrew: before fallback; numbers: baseline (v1): 2.8ms/token p95, after FA merge: 3.3ms/token p95, throughput down from 1450 tok/s to 1200 tok/s on A100-80GB
sara: any memory changes or KV cache churn?
andrew: mem peak +120MB per worker; KV hit-rate looks fine but cache write amplification increased in paged policy metrics
kiran: quick theory — FA variant changed tiling and causes more page table thrash for our paged attention allocator. Related FA PR: flash-attention/flash-attn#312 (merged yesterday). Also saw vLLM staging branch has a patch that tweaks KV layout (vllm/vllm#89) — might interact
leila: ci-bot, can you run the performance canary against the commit before and after FA#312?
ci-bot: scheduled perf job 2026-04-03T14:12:00Z, will run two commits (pre-merge and post-merge) across xformers-pinned and our patched runtime. results expected in ~45m
andrew: repro steps I used: ```python -m bench.attn --model gpt2-xl --seq 2048 --batch 8 --runs 120 --use-paged``` add --kv-caching to match production
leila: also throw in fused-attn path: I want to see fused vs paged delta now that FA changed op ordering
sara: small TODO: pin flash-attn to commit sha abcdef12 in Dedicated queue while we triage. Kiran, can you create a short rollback patch? If it isolates, we can ship a quick revert in staging
kiran: will open a PR to pin + add a toggle flag for FA variant selection. PR draft: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime#452. If CI repros, we'll canary pin for Dedicated for 24h
leila: xFormers note — their nightly bumped to 0.2.0-rc which dropped a fused kernel wrapper we use. we should avoid bump until we validate. added a blocker issue in tracking board: PERF-598
andrew: one more datapoint — profiling flamegraph shows extra cycles in CUDA kernel launch overhead and small kernels that previously were fused are now split (more small launches). That aligns with the fused->paged shift
sara: plan: 1) wait for CI canary results 2) if confirmed, pin FA and xformers in Dedicated + replace image in canary 3) run a full regression bench across seq lengths (512/1024/2048) 4) open downstream issue for vLLM KV layout interaction and request upstream guidance
leila: tagging eng-runtime on the tracking card and cc @platform-team for deploy gating. Also, if we need immediate rollback in prod Dedicated, ops runbook: revert image to sha: 3a1b5c and scale down new nodes, then redeploy older pool
andrew: CI results in: pre-merge tokens/s=1487, post-merge tokens/s=1210, p95 pre=2.7ms, p95 post=3.2ms. so confirmed regression. attaching profiler snippet below:
```
# kernel summary
Name                            Time%
flash_attn_fused_forward        42.1
launch_overhead                 18.7
paged_attention_split_k         15.6
other                          23.6
```
kiran: thanks. i'm going to revert FA variant selection in our runtime while we file upstream bug with flash-attn PR describing the small-launch regression. I'll also add a test that validates end-to-end token latency doesn't degrade by >5% after third-party bumps
sara: good. keep this thread updated. if anyone hits user-facing errors open an incident and ping eng-sre. :thumbsup:
